name: Soest (Germany)
description: Banner of the city arms of Soest: white with a red key with a crenellated bow in the hoist and red horizontal bars in the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Soest; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: key with crenellated bow from the city arms
